title: Muraja'ah: An-Nazi'at and An-Naba' 1 to 8: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Summer 1: An-Naba' and Al-Qadr as a model
source: Written for quran/y7 lesson 38 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Muraja'ah rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 38. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ (٣٤) يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ (٣٥) وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ (٣٦) فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ (٣٧) وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا (٣٨) فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ (٣٩) وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ (٤٠) فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ (٤١)

questions.q: Chain recitation: An-Nazi'at 27 to 46, one ayah per pupil, then An-Naba' 1 to 8.
Rota: today's group recites An-Nazi'at 27 to 46 and An-Naba' 1 to 8 to the teacher. Everyone else: 3-3-link weak ayat and fill the rota.
Extend: write your three weakest ayat in the portal log.
questions.a: Three ayat listed with a plan.
A) what was learned recently. Sabaq is new, sabqi recent, manzil older.

questions.q: Recite An-Nazi'at 79:42 in your head. How does the next ayah begin?
Think again: When you learn a new surah, which old surah is most at risk of slipping, and why?
questions.a: The one just before it, because we stop revising it once it feels finished.
